units.source_text: K的倾诉告一段落时，我已经什么话也说不出来了。

en.t: By the time K's confession had come to an end, I could no longer say anything at all.

units.source_text: 我的沉默并非因为在盘算利弊得失，譬如我现在也应该在他面前作同样的表白呢，还是先不表白比较明智等等。

en.t: My silence was not because I was weighing the advantages and disadvantages, wondering whether I too ought to make the same confession before him now, or whether it would be wiser not to confess yet.

units.source_text: 我只是什么也说不出，而且也不想说。

en.t: I simply could not say anything, and I did not want to say anything either.

units.source_text: 吃午饭的时候，K和我相对而坐。

en.t: At lunch, K and I sat facing each other.

units.source_text: 在女佣的伺候下，我吃完了这顿有生以来最难吃的饭。

en.t: Served by the maid, I finished the most tasteless meal I had ever eaten in my life.

units.source_text: 吃饭时，两个人几乎没有说话，

en.t: During the meal, the two of us hardly spoke,

units.source_text: 也不知夫人和小姐什么时候才会回来。

en.t: and we did not know when the lady of the house and the young lady would return.
